Report as a structured list with file:line citations. Do not propose changes. Be exhaustive.

## 2. CUDA kernel source strings & the twelve-mark interpreter

### Memory-layout constants (Rust side, `gpu_kernel.rs:25-27`)
- `STRIDE = 64` — per-thread program stride in the flat `progs` buffer.
- `SDEPTH = 256` — value-stack depth.
- `META = 32` — per-thread output-meta words (classical state + banked tri face).
- Mirrored inside the kernels at `gpu_kernel.rs:54` and `:244`: `const int STRIDE = PROGRAM_CAP, SDEPTH = 256, FCAP = 64, META = 32;`
- `PROGRAM_CAP` — CUDA `#define`, default 64 (`gpu_kernel.rs:43-44`, `:231-232`), overridable via `#define PROGRAM_CAP …` prepend (`gpu_kernel.rs:3297`). `STRIDE` inside the kernel is bound to `PROGRAM_CAP`.
- `FCAP = 64` — fork-frame stack cap (`fresume/fright/fset` arrays, `gpu_kernel.rs:64`, `:264`).

### `KERNEL_SRC` — entry `run_programs` (`gpu_kernel.rs:42-220`)
The flat twelve-mark interpreter. One IMASM program per thread. Reads `progs`/`lens`, runs the token engine to a halt or `max_ticks`, writes final value-stack to `out_stack[gid*SDEPTH…]` and state to `out_meta[gid*META…]` (`:211-218`: m[0]=halted, m[1]=ticks, m[2]=top, m[3..11]=reg[0..8], m[11]=engagr, m[12..16]=mem[0..4]).

The **twelve-mark token engine** (the "twelve marks" interpreter) dispatches token ids 0–15 (`gpu_kernel.rs:101-203`):
- 0 VINIT (push N/0), 1 TANCH (pop→mem, halt if no open fork), 2 AFWD (reg0++), 3 AREV (bit-not top, reg0--), 4 CLINK (reg3=reg1&reg2), 5 EVALT (keep-if-T), 6 FSPLIT (scan for matching FFUSE, push fork frame), 7 FFUSE (b4_join left|right, resume), 8 IMSCRIB (snapshot diversity/self_ref/frob_pos/dial into reg4-7; precomputed at `:70-91`), 9 EVALF (keep-if-F), 10 ENGAGR (engagr=1, push 3), 11 IFIX (pop→mem), 12 FSPLIT3 / 13 FFUSE3 (three-way delta union, `:145-171`), 14 EVALI (info part), 15 ROTAT (rotate stack right by k, triple-reverse `:190-202`). Marks 8 and 12/13/14 are excluded from verified programs (`:204`).

### `KERNEL_NESTED_SRC` — entry `run_nested` (`gpu_kernel.rs:230-…`, guarded by `#ifndef IMASM_FACTOR_RELATION`)
`concat!` of a `PROGRAM_CAP` define + `gpu_banked.cuh` + `gpu_relation.cuh` + the nested kernel body (`:230-234`). Each thread runs the *same* inner word as `run_programs`, but **every inner step is fetched/decoded/executed by an interpreter word held on the card** — `unsigned char INTERP[12] = {0,2,4,6,7,5,9,10,11,3,1,15};` run as a real IMASM program on a scratch context (`mstack/mreg/mmem`) before each inner action fires (`:254-258`). This is "IMASM interpreting IMASM on the card." It also calls `banked_word(P,plen,&out_meta[gid*META+16])` to compute the SIXTEEN_3 banked tri face into meta words 16–31 (`:252`). Emits inner ticks (m[1]) and nested ticks separately (`:267-268`). When compiled with `IMASM_FACTOR_RELATION` (via `gpu_relation.cuh`), the same source instead exposes `run_compact`, `run_compact_rehash`, `run_relation_control`, `run_relation_epoch`, `run_witness_limb`, `run_tensor_enfold_ops` (loaded at `gpu_kernel.rs:2572-2578`).
